description_en: This API is used to query the history of major version upgrade jobs for RDS PostgreSQL instances.
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS PostgreSQL实例大版本升级的历史任务
name: DescribeUpgradeMajorVersionTasks

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 30 to 100.

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数。

取值：30~100。

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Pages start from 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The major engine version of the new instance. Valid values:

10.0
11.0
12.0
13.0
14.0
15.0
parameters.name: target_major_version

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: task_id

Items.description_en: The tasks for major engine version upgrades

items.description_en: Details of a major version upgrade job.

CollectStatMode.description_en:
The time when the system collects the statistics.

Valid values:

After: The system collects the statistics after a switchover.
Before: The system collects the statistics before a switchover
CollectStatMode.description_zh:
统计信息收集模式。

取值范围：
After：割接后升级。
Before：割接前升级

Detail.example:
2021-10-27 15:03:05 --- do upgrade precheck on slave succcess.
2021-10-27 15:03:11 --- begin to upgrade major version, source instance will locked in readonly mode.
2021-10-27 15:03:21 --- upgrade master success.
2021-10-27 15:06:10 --- exchange source and target instance dns success.

EndTime.description_en:
The end time of the task.

This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC. Unit: milliseconds
EndTime.description_zh:
大版本升级结束时间。

以Unix时间戳表示。单位：毫秒

Result.description_en:
The status of the task.

Success: The task is successful.
Failed: The task failed.
Running: The task is in the phase in which data is being migrated to a new instance
Result.description_zh:
展示任务最终是否成功。
Success：成功。
Failed：失败。
Running：迁移中

SourceInsName.description_en: The ID of the original instance

SourceMajorVersion.description_en: The major engine version of the original instance
SourceMajorVersion.description_zh: 升级前原实例的版本号

StartTime.description_en:
The start time of the task.

This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC. Unit: milliseconds
StartTime.description_zh:
大版本升级开始时间。

以Unix时间戳表示。单位：毫秒

SwitchEndTime.description_en:
The end time of the switching from the original instance to the new instance.

Expressed in Unix timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
SwitchEndTime.description_zh:
业务从原实例切换至新实例的结束时间。

以Unix时间戳表示。单位：毫秒

SwitchTime.description_en:
The time at which your workloads are switched over from the original instance to the new instance.

This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC. Unit: milliseconds
SwitchTime.description_zh:
业务从原实例切换至新实例的时间。

以Unix时间戳表示。单位：毫秒

TargetInsName.description_en: The ID of the new instance

TargetMajorVersion.description_en:
The major engine version of the new instance. Valid values:

10.0
11.0
12.0
13.0
14.0
15.0

UpgradeMode.description_en:
The upgrade mode.

Valid values:

clone: The system does not migrate data to the new instance and does not switch your workloads over to the new instance.
switch: The system migrates data to the new instance and switches your workloads over to the new instance
UpgradeMode.description_zh:
升级模式。

取值范围：
clone：不割接
switch：割接

cutOver.description_en:
Indicates whether a switch is performed.

true: Yes.
false: No
cutOver.description_zh:
是否割接。

true：是。
false：否

totalLogicRepDelayTime.description_en:
Estimated synchronization time for logical replication delay, in seconds.  
This is used only for zero-downtime major version upgrades.
totalLogicRepDelayTime.description_zh:
逻辑复制延迟预估同步时间，单位：秒。
仅用于零停机大版本升级

totalLogicRepLatencyMB.description_en:
Logical replication delay size, in MB.

Applies only to zero-downtime major version upgrades
totalLogicRepLatencyMB.description_zh:
逻辑复制延迟大小，单位：MB。

仅用于零停机大版本升级

zeroDownTimeConnectionString.description_en:
Temporary internal endpoint for zero-downtime major version upgrade, in the format `****.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`.  
Applies only to zero-downtime major version upgrades
zeroDownTimeConnectionString.description_zh:
零停机大版本升级的高版本临时内网连接地址，格式为`****.pg.rds.aliyuncs.com`。
仅用于零停机大版本升级

zeroDownTimePort.description_en:
Port of the higher-version instance, which is the same as the source instance port.  
Applies only to zero-downtime major version upgrades
zeroDownTimePort.description_zh:
高版本实例端口，与源实例端口保持一致。
仅用于零停机大版本升级

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
